# ZSS System Reference

> Architecture, glossary, and developer docs for Zed Cafe / Zed Software System.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://zed.cafe/docs): Zed Cafe developer documentation — system reference for ZSS.
- [System map](https://zed.cafe/docs/map): Product stack (including Wanix complex-data plane), realms and workers, tick loop, and script pipeline.
- [Glossary](https://zed.cafe/docs/glossary): Terms used across Zed Cafe / ZSS — product, world model, devices, and more.
- [Architecture](https://zed.cafe/docs/architecture): Pointer to the ZSS architecture deep dive and runtime overview.

## Features

- [Features](https://zed.cafe/docs/features): Feature domains across the fantasy terminal — CLI, inspector, synth, multiplayer, and more.
- [Audio & synth](https://zed.cafe/docs/features/audio-synth): Audio & synth features in Zed Cafe / ZSS.
- [Board & world building](https://zed.cafe/docs/features/board-world-building): Board & world building features in Zed Cafe / ZSS.
- [CLI / headless](https://zed.cafe/docs/features/cli-headless): CLI / headless features in Zed Cafe / ZSS.
- [Code editor & tape](https://zed.cafe/docs/features/code-editor-tape): Code editor & tape features in Zed Cafe / ZSS.
- [Element scripting](https://zed.cafe/docs/features/element-scripting): Element scripting features in Zed Cafe / ZSS.
- [Import / export / parse](https://zed.cafe/docs/features/import-export-parse): Import / export / parse features in Zed Cafe / ZSS.
- [Inspector & gadget tools](https://zed.cafe/docs/features/inspector-gadget-tools): Inspector & gadget tools features in Zed Cafe / ZSS.
- [Multiplayer & social](https://zed.cafe/docs/features/multiplayer-social): Multiplayer & social features in Zed Cafe / ZSS.
- [Permissions & moderation](https://zed.cafe/docs/features/permissions-moderation): Permissions & moderation features in Zed Cafe / ZSS.
- [Rendering & input](https://zed.cafe/docs/features/rendering-input): Rendering & input features in Zed Cafe / ZSS.
- [Speech & TTS](https://zed.cafe/docs/features/speech-tts): Speech & TTS features in Zed Cafe / ZSS.
- [Storage & session](https://zed.cafe/docs/features/storage-session): Storage & session features in Zed Cafe / ZSS.
- [Terminal & CLI](https://zed.cafe/docs/features/terminal-cli): Terminal & CLI features in Zed Cafe / ZSS.
- [Wanix & zedsync](https://zed.cafe/docs/features/wanix-zedsync): First-class complex-data plane — iframe OS, zedcafe export, and peer sync.

## Wanix

- [Wanix](https://zed.cafe/docs/wanix): First-class complex-data plane — iframe OS, zedcafe export, tasks/VM, and zedsync.
- [Wanix integration](https://zed.cafe/docs/wanix/integration): Browser OS iframe, zedcafe export, task/VM rooms, terminals, and message protocol.
- [Zedsync](https://zed.cafe/docs/wanix/zedsync): Mirror zedcafe export with a peer directory via FSA drop or remote 9P (`#wanix zedsync`).
